messages:
Emma (ops): Random question for the room — what's one tiny hotel amenity that would make you choose one place over another? 🤔
Raj Patel: Free decent coffee in the lobby. Not the mystery brown sludge. Actual espresso machine :raised_hands:
Kai Nakamura: A proper luggage rack. Hate living out of a suitcase on the floor.
Sophie L.: USB-A + USB-C outlets by the bed. Why is this still a hill I have to die on. :roll_eyes: @Kai
Mike - infra: Extra-long towels. Always. Also blackout curtains that actually block light.
Emma (ops): @Raj yes to the espresso. Also a little tray or shelf in the shower for soap/shampoo — the tiny ledge that doesn't exist is my nemesis.
Raj Patel: Amen. And a small, honest mini-fridge (no mystery sticky shelf).
Kai Nakamura: Bonus points for a bedside dimmer switch with an actual lamp and not just one overhead harsh light.
Sophie L.: Shower water pressure that isn't a sad drizzle. Is that too much to ask? :laughing:
Mike - infra: If budget hotels offered a cheap foldable drying rack in the closet, I'd pick them every time (for travelers who pack light).
lunchbot: Don't forget the universal adapter in the welcome packet! :earth_americas: (poll: would you use it?)
Emma (ops): Quick poll — would you rather have (A) great coffee, (B) reliable outlets, or (C) blackout curtains? Reply with A/B/C.
Raj Patel: A
Kai Nakamura: B
Sophie L.: B
Mike - infra: C
Emma (ops): Results so far: A:1 B:2 C:1. Keep votes coming. This is crucial research for my next business trip. :sunglasses:
